pages.text: Festival music filled the village square. Everyone held hands and danced in the middle.
Lulu tapped both feet. "I want to dance there with my cousins too."
Aunt Rosa blocked the way. "Wait! Dancing needs lots of ribbons!"
She tied ribbons on the cousins' heads, then tails, then ankles.
"One more here!" More and more ribbons came from her hands.
Meanwhile, a whole song ended. Applause rose from the square.
As a new song began, Lulu took a cousin's hand and ran straight in.
Round and round, hop and hop! All the ribbons swung.
A skirt fluttered! Already Aunt Rosa was spinning biggest in the middle. Ribbons dangled from her head.
